subject: Finexa - Security evidence & buying process (SOC2, pentest, procurement next steps)
messages:
From: Amelia Rogers <amelia.rogers@finexa.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@finexa.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood - Security and buying process follow-up

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo today — that cleared up a lot. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can move to procurement: 

- Economic buyer: Tom Hayes (VP of Product) will need a short cost/benefit note from you (1 pager) for his review.
- Security: Our InfoSec team needs the latest SOC 2 report and a summary of the most recent penetration test.
- Data handling: Can you confirm retention policy for customer data and whether audit logs can be exported to our SIEM?
- Procurement: We use DocuSign and have a standard PO process; finance will need a W-9 and vendor contact.

Can you send the SOC2 and pentest summary by EOD Thursday? Also, please include the list of internal Redwood reviewers we should expect to see on evidence.

Best,
Amelia
Senior Engineering Manager
Finexa

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Rogers <amelia.rogers@finexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood - Security and buying process follow-up

Amelia — thanks for the clear notes and the list. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) Economic buyer note: I'll draft a one-page cost/benefit summary targeted at Tom and share by tomorrow morning.
2) SOC 2 / Pentest: Attaching our SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and the pentest executive summary. Full pen-test technical details we share under NDA; if that’s needed we can get the right SRE contact looped in.
3) Data retention / audit logs: We retain customer data per contract; standard retention is 90 days for transient logs and 1 year for audit logs by default — we can extend contractual retention if required. Audit logs are exportable via S3-compatible dump or pushed to a customer SIEM via our secure forwarding integration. I included a short csv sample of audit logs.
4) Procurement paperwork: I’ll attach our W-9 and vendor contact details.

Next steps:
- I will share the one-pager for Tom by 2026-02-26 11:00 PT.
- If InfoSec wants the full pentest report, please confirm the NDA contact (Priya?).
- Marissa will pick up procurement coordination for vendor setup.

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_Report_2025.pdf; pentest_summary_2025.pdf; redwood-audit-logs-sample.csv; Redwood_W9.pdf

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Menon <priya.menon@finexa.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Amelia Rogers <amelia.rogers@finexa.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood - Security and buying process follow-up

Ben — quick follow-up from InfoSec. They want answers to these specific questions before the procurement rubric: 

- Do you have live role-based access controls (RBAC) and integration with SSO via SAML/SCIM?
- Can you provide retention/erase policy language we can flip into our contract (specifically for backups and audit logs)?
- Are encryption keys customer-managed (KMS/HSM) for Private deployments, and is there a bring-your-own-key option for Dedicated?

Also, could you confirm whether the audit-log CSV contains user IDs in hashed form or plaintext? We need to understand PII exposure.

If you can answer these in-line that would help speed the procurement rubric.

Thanks,
Priya
Security & Compliance
Finexa

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Priya Menon <priya.menon@finexa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-27T11:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood - Security and buying process follow-up

Priya — answers inline below.

- RBAC & SSO: Yes. We support RBAC with role templates and SSO via SAML 2.0 and SCIM for user provisioning. We can provide our SCIM schema for your IdP team.
- Retention/erase policy: Our standard contract language allows configurable retention windows for logs/backups; we can provide a contract clause that states default retention is 90 days for transient logs and 365 days for audit logs, with amendments to extend to customer-specified periods. I attached the contract snippet we usually share.
- KMS/HSM: For Private deployments we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) via KMS/HSM. For Dedicated we offer optional BYOK if deployed in the customer's cloud tenancy; otherwise keys are managed with strict access controls at Redwood.
- Audit log CSV: User identifiers are pseudonymized (hashed) by default in the sample. We can provide a mapping under a stricter NDA if needed.

If InfoSec needs the technical pen-test appendix, we will require an NDA before sharing raw findings. Otherwise, the executive summary should be sufficient for the initial procurement risk assessment.

— Alex
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hayes <thayes@finexa.com>, Amelia Rogers <amelia.rogers@finexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Finexa executive summary + next steps (SOC2, procurement)

Tom / Amelia — attaching the one-page cost/benefit summary for Tom, plus the SOC2 and pentest summary we shared earlier. Quick proposed timeline to keep momentum: 

- Week of Mar 8: Legal & procurement review contract language (Marissa to support and provide vendor info).
- Mar 15: InfoSec clarifies if NDA is required for full pentest appendix. If yes, we will exchange NDA and then share the appendix.
- Mar 22: Target decision meeting with Tom (economic buyer) and InfoSec.

Action items:
- Tom: please confirm availability for a 30-min decision sync on or after Mar 22.
- Priya / InfoSec: confirm whether the executive pentest appendix is required (NDA) or if summary suffices for procurement rubric.
- Marissa: I'll loop finance for PO and vendor onboarding once Tom signs off.

Links: https://drive.google.com/finexa-redwood-security-evidence (contains SOC2_Type2_Report_2025.pdf, pentest_summary_2025.pdf, redwood-audit-logs-sample.csv)

Thanks everyone — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
